stem: When preparing a patient for transfer to a specialist burns unit, why is 'Glad Wrap' (plastic wrap) recommended as a temporary dressing?

options.text: It provides a sterile environment that eliminates the need for further cleaning.
It allows for easy visibility of the burn and prevents excessive fluid loss.
It is the only dressing that can be safely wrapped circumferentially around limbs.
It contains a specialized silver-ion coating that begins the healing process.

explanation: Plastic wrap is cheap, non-adherent, maintains visibility for assessment, and acts as a barrier to evaporation.
rationale: Focus on the practical benefits for the receiving specialist who needs to see the wound.

optionExplanations.A: While it prevents contamination, it is not a sterile environment that precludes the need for specialized cleaning upon arrival.
optionExplanations.B: Plastic wrap is cheap, non-adherent, maintains visibility for assessment, and acts as a barrier to evaporation.
optionExplanations.C: The source specifically warns that plastic wrap should NOT be applied circumferentially due to the risk of constriction.
optionExplanations.D: Standard plastic wrap does not contain antimicrobial agents; silver dressings are separate, more expensive products.

source.hint: Focus on the practical benefits for the receiving specialist who needs to see the wound.
